entities.summary: Enrique "Ricky" Martín Morales is a Puerto Rican singer, songwriter and actor. He is known for his musical versatility, with his discography incorporating a wide variety of many elements, such as Latin pop, dance, reggaeton, salsa, and other genres. Born in San Juan, Martin began appearing in television commercials at age nine and began his musical career at twelve, as a member of Puerto Rican boy band Menudo. He began his solo career in 1991 while in Sony Music Mexico, gaining recognition in Latin America with the release of his first two studio albums, Ricky Martin (1991) and Me Amaras (1993), both of which were focused on ballads.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ricky Martin's early career in Menudo and subsequent solo releases helped popularize Latin pop music in the 1990s, contributing to the genre's global growth. His success paved the way for future Latinx artists in mainstream music.
